title: Network authority: default deny, label-wise hosts, pinned addresses
note: An egress allowlist is bypassed by strings, not by exploits. Most of these mutations turn one careful comparison into a careless one -- label matching into string matching, an explicit port into an assumed one, a safe method into any method -- and each turns a specific grant into a general one. W1 is the sharpest: with no grant the answer must be no, and a default-allow here is indistinguishable from having no network authority at all.

mutations.name: W1_no_grant_means_allow
mutations.rationale: with no grant the answer becomes yes, which is the same as having no network authority

mutations.name: W2_uncovered_request_allowed
mutations.rationale: a request no grant covers is permitted anyway

mutations.name: W3_host_matching_becomes_a_suffix_compare
mutations.rationale: 'evil-api.example.com' passes an allowlist for 'api.example.com'

mutations.name: W4_wildcard_covers_the_apex
mutations.find: return len(h) > len(stem) and h[-len(stem):] == stem
mutations.replace: return len(h) >= len(stem) and h[-len(stem):] == stem
mutations.rationale: granting subdomains silently grants the apex too

mutations.name: W5_bare_wildcard_host_accepted
mutations.rationale: a single character grants the entire internet

mutations.name: W6_userinfo_confusion_allowed
mutations.rationale: 'https://allowed.example@evil.test/' reads as the allowed host and connects elsewhere

mutations.name: W7_missing_port_defaults_silently
mutations.rationale: an unknown scheme is silently treated as if it were https

mutations.name: W8_port_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a grant for 443 covers every port on the host

mutations.name: W9_scheme_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a grant for https covers plaintext http, which was the point of naming https

mutations.name: W10_method_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a read-only grant performs writes on the far side

mutations.name: W11_unknown_method_assumed_safe
mutations.rationale: a method this layer cannot classify passes as if it were a GET

mutations.name: W12_path_scope_ignored
mutations.rationale: a grant scoped to /v1 reaches /admin

mutations.name: W13_path_prefix_becomes_a_string_compare
mutations.rationale: path scope becomes a raw string prefix, so a grant for '/v1' also covers '/v1secrets' -- a different path that merely starts with the same characters

mutations.name: W14_traversing_path_accepted
mutations.rationale: a path that climbs out of the granted prefix is accepted

mutations.name: W15_subject_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a grant becomes a bearer token any actor can present

mutations.name: W16_task_binding_ignored
mutations.rationale: a component is tricked into reaching the network on another task's behalf

mutations.name: W17_tool_binding_ignored
mutations.rationale: the grant issued for a schema fetch authorizes any tool

mutations.name: W18_expiry_ignored
mutations.rationale: an expired grant keeps working

mutations.name: W19_revocation_ignored
mutations.rationale: a withdrawn grant still authorizes egress

mutations.name: W20_address_class_ignored
mutations.rationale: a public-internet grant reaches loopback and the cloud metadata endpoint

mutations.name: W21_pinned_addresses_ignored
mutations.find: if g.addresses and addr not in g.addresses:
mutations.rationale: a name whose answer changed between the check and the connect is accepted

mutations.name: W22_unspecified_address_classed_as_private
mutations.rationale: 0.0.0.0 is classed as private, so a grant permitting private ranges covers it

mutations.name: W23_socket_guard_allows_unpinned
mutations.find: if g is not None and not g.allow_unpinned_addresses:
mutations.rationale: the resolve-then-connect window is left open without anyone having accepted it

mutations.name: W24_socket_guard_ignores_the_pin
mutations.rationale: the socket layer stops checking the address the connection actually goes to

mutations.name: W25_socket_guard_permits_unauthorized_connects
mutations.rationale: a dependency that phones home is no longer stopped

mutations.name: W26_socket_guard_not_removed
mutations.rationale: the guard stays installed after the block ends, so every later connection in the process is judged by a grant that is no longer in scope

mutations.name: W27_unclassifiable_address_waved_through
mutations.rationale: a UNIX-domain connect passes a guard that cannot reason about it

mutations.name: W28_grant_digest_not_verified
mutations.rationale: a rewritten grant passes as the one whose digest was recorded

mutations.name: W29_unknown_grant_fields_projected
mutations.rationale: a grant written by a newer version is projected with fields this reader drops

mutations.name: W30_grant_id_reuse_allowed
mutations.rationale: two different grants become indistinguishable in the log

mutations.name: W31_denied_decision_does_not_raise
mutations.rationale: raise_if_denied stops refusing; every caller relying on it fails open

mutations.name: W32_denials_not_recorded
mutations.rationale: the audit trail records that something happened but not what was attempted

mutations.name: W33_empty_path_prefix_list_denies_nothing_visibly
mutations.rationale: path scoping is disabled entirely while the field still appears in the grant

mutations.name: W34_oversized_url_accepted
mutations.rationale: an unbounded destination string is parsed rather than refused

mutations.name: W35_hostless_url_accepted
mutations.find:
if not host:
        raise MalformedTarget("target URL has no host")
mutations.replace:
if False:
        raise MalformedTarget("target URL has no host")
mutations.rationale: a URL with no host reaches host matching with nothing to match

mutations.name: E36_egress_grant_covers_traffic_that_predates_it
mutations.rationale: a grant written afterwards answers 'was this egress permitted at the time' with yes

mutations.name: E37_a_backdated_egress_grant_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: the digest binds the body including the start it names, so a self-consistent backdated grant loads clean

mutations.name: E38_a_second_grant_under_one_id_replaces_the_first
mutations.rationale: a record naming a live grant_id with wider hosts silently widens authority already in force

mutations.name: E39_the_authority_takes_the_start_from_its_caller
mutations.rationale: the caller chooses where its own egress grant begins

mutations.name: E40_the_egress_body_is_not_checked_for_secrets
mutations.find:
refusal = _refuse_secret_pairing(decision, body, secrets)
                return refusal if refusal is not None else decision
mutations.rationale: two individually correct grants compose into exfiltration and nothing in the request path asks

mutations.name: E41_a_body_carrying_a_secret_is_waved_through
mutations.rationale: the value-based detection runs and its answer is discarded

mutations.name: E42_an_unavailable_secret_store_becomes_permission
mutations.find:
return replace(decision, allowed=False,
                       reason=("the secret store could not be consulted "
mutations.rationale: a store that cannot answer turns into a yes, which is the fail-open direction
